checks.name: one row per store per day
totals match the snapshots
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.store_daily_stock d full outer join (select store_id, snapshot_date, sum(units_on_hand) as units_on_hand, count(distinct case when units_on_hand > 0 then sku end) as skus_in_stock from raw.stock_levels group by 1, 2) e using (store_id, snapshot_date) where d.units_on_hand is distinct from e.units_on_hand or d.skus_in_stock is distinct from e.skus_in_stock
